outcome: After this story a maintainer running `git grep -i koala -- 'packages/*/src/**'` sees ONLY the residue-gate self-identifiers KOALA_RESIDUE_* in handlers/review-preflight.ts (deferred to story 4); every other koala token in packages/*/src is gone or renamed to lattice. `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0, the packages/main suite is green, and `node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs` still prints PASS.
facts: packages/*/src has ~311 koala hits / 71 files: A=8 signature salts (14), B=legacy-detection (~40: bin/koala*.js + .codex/koala.json denylist, @koala-agent old-install handling, isKoalaSelfRepoBootstrap), C=4 schema ids (koala.capability_probe/list.v1, koala.evidence_manifest/inspect.v1), D=config (idleKoala field, koala.config.json filename, koalaConfig ~22), E=.koala/ runtime paths (~21), F=residue-gate self KOALA_RESIDUE_* (~21, story 4), plus ~177 stray comments/strings.

Renaming a signature salt VALUE invalidates every _hash signed with the old salt; in-flight stories will report tampered on their next gate and must re-run init-check/review/delivery (user-accepted collateral).
Per B-3f13, this story's OWN gate signatures must be produced by the WORKTREE binary (new salt); signing via the global lattice (main's old-salt dist) would self-reject as tampered.
Under the user's no-compat directive, old koala-named config (koala.config.json, idleKoala) and .koala/ runtime data are NOT migrated — OSS users start fresh.
constraints: Change producers and consumers of each renamed token atomically; no half-rename.
Sign every gate in this story via the worktree binary (new salt).
Do NOT touch the residue-gate self-IDs (KOALA_RESIDUE_* in review-preflight.ts + scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs = story 4), docs/experiments (story 4), or .lattice/story history.
Keep tsc + the packages/main suite green and the residue gate PASS.
